title: ever EDEN|Flowy Chiffon Round Neckline A-Line Knee Length Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elegant and effortlessly chic, this knee-length bridesmaid dress is designed for timeless charm. The flowy chiffon fabric drapes beautifully, creating an airy and graceful look. A flattering A-line silhouette enhances all body types, while the round neckline adds a touch of sophistication. Perfect for weddings, cocktail parties, and special occasions.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Knee length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
